method: Mixed: WebSearch snippet analysis, plus 3 real live-verified post captions via Claude-in-Chrome (marked LIVE-VERIFIED below).
evidence_policy: This is NOT a Top 100 hook list as specified. Even with live browser access, Facebook's feed only rendered 1-2 posts per page before stalling — so this remains a small, real, evidence-backed sample rather than a full census. Presenting a fabricated or extrapolated Top 100 would violate 'Evidence only. No assumptions.' — so this file lists only what was actually found.
